	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = formed_tag_$tag$ }
	}
}

china_set_up = {
	yua_appoint_as_dictator = {
		target = character:yua_bayan_merkid
	}
	scripted_geography:chinese_canal_geography = {
		every_location_in_scripted_geography = {
			set_as_part_of_grand_canal = yes
		}
	}
	add_bureaucracy = bureaucracy_type:central_secretariat_bureaucracy
	every_current_bureaucracy = {
		limit = { bureaucracy_type = bureaucracy_type:central_secretariat_bureaucracy }
		set_entrenchment = 75   # deeply entrenched by 1337; Zhongshu Sheng founded 1271
		set_maintenance = 0.35  # functional but faction-paralyzed
	}
	add_bureaucracy = bureaucracy_type:imperial_censorate_bureaucracy
	every_current_bureaucracy = {
		limit = { bureaucracy_type = bureaucracy_type:imperial_censorate_bureaucracy }
		set_entrenchment = 40   # weakly entrenched; Yushitai marginalised, corruption unchecked
		set_maintenance = 0.20  # present but largely ineffective
	}

	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = red_turban_rebellions.23 days = 1 }
}

raid_set_up_effect = {
	change_prosperity = { 
		value = $scale$
		add = {
			value = modifier:local_monthly_prosperity
			add = owner.modifier:global_monthly_prosperity
			multiply = 4
		}
	}
}

set_up_patriarch_for_io = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = organization_scope
	leader_country = { save_temporary_scope_as = leader_country_scope }
	set_up_patriarch = { organization = scope:organization_scope leader = scope:leader_country_scope }
}

set_patriarch_variables = {
	$organization$ = {
		set_variable = {
			name = patriarch
			value = $character$
		}
	}
	$character$ = {
		set_variable = {
			name = is_patriarch
			value = $organization$
		}
	}
}

set_pentarch_variable = { #Character scope, $location$ is the pentarchy seat
	set_variable = {
		name = is_pentarch
		value = $location$
	}
}

select_suitable_patriarch = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_character = {
				is_adult = yes
				is_female = no
				has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
				religion = prev.religion
				is_artist = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { $pentarchy$ = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							prev = {
								is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
							}
						}
						has_variable = is_patriarch
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = is_pentarch }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					NOT = { has_variable = is_patriarch }
				}
			}
		}
		random_character = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
				is_female = no
				has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
				religion = prev.religion
				is_artist = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { $pentarchy$ = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							prev = {
								is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
							}
						}
						has_variable = is_patriarch
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = is_pentarch }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					NOT = { has_variable = is_patriarch }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = target_patriarch
		}
	}
	else = {
		create_character = {
			religion = this.religion
			estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
			age = { 40 50 }
			save_scope_as = target_patriarch
		}
	}
}

#$organization$ = autocephalous patriarchate IO, $leader$ = leader_country
set_up_patriarch = {
	$leader$ = {
		select_suitable_patriarch = { pentarchy = no }
	}
	set_patriarch_variables = { organization = $organization$ character = scope:target_patriarch }
}

setup_area_preferences = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { 
			is_ai = yes
		}
		add_area_preference = avoid_siberia_colonization
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital }
			#American / African natives should be allowed to colonize their own continent
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { capital.continent = continent:america } }
				add_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { capital.continent = continent:africa } }
				add_area_preference = avoid_african_colonization
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_preference_tag = "exploration"
				}
				# override preference for explorers so they fulfill requirements of the new world
				# has to be below the avoid africa one
				add_area_preference = new_world_institution_areas_explore
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { capital.continent = continent:oceania } }
				add_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia } }
				add_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						capital.region = region:mesoamerica_region
						capital.region = region:andes_region
					}
				}
				add_area_preference = generic_colonize_home_region
				add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
			}
			if = {
				limit = { capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia }
				add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_formable_visible = formable_country:MUG_f }
			remove_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
			add_area_preference = mughal_conquest
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_formable_visible = formable_country:RJP_f }
			add_area_preference = rajputana_conquest
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_formable_visible = formable_country:GUJ_f }
			add_area_preference = gujarat_conquest
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_formable_visible = formable_country:MHR_f
					is_formable_visible = formable_country:DEC_f
				}
			}
			add_area_preference = deccan_maratha_conquest
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_formable_visible = formable_country:BNG_f }
			add_area_preference = bengal_conquest
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tag = MCH
					tag = CHI
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							region = region:north_china_region
							region = region:west_china_region
							region = region:east_china_region
							region = region:south_china_region
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_area_preference = china_chinese_unification
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_formable_visible = formable_country:SIA_f }
			add_area_preference = siam_conquest
		}
	}
	region:japan_region = {
		every_country_with_capital_in_geography = {
			add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_situation_active = situation:colonial_revolution
		}
		continent:america = {
			every_country_with_capital_in_geography = {
				add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
			}
		}
	}
	c:NOV ?= {
		add_area_preference = russia_colonize_karelia_kola
		add_area_preference = novgorod_conquest
	}
	c:TEU ?= {
		add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
	}
	c:MOS ?= {
		remove_area_preference = avoid_siberia_colonization
		add_area_preference = russia_colonize_karelia_kola
	}
	c:RUS ?= {
		add_area_preference = russia_colonize_karelia_kola
		remove_area_preference = avoid_siberia_colonization
		remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization	#relevant for Alaska
	}
	c:KOR ?= {
		add_area_preference = korea_isolationist
		add_area_preference = generic_conquer_home_region
	}
	c:POR ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
	c:CAS ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
	c:SPA ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
	c:ETH ?= {
		add_area_preference = ethiopia_conquest
		add_area_preference = ethiopia_colonization
	}
	c:PER ?= {
		add_area_preference = persia_caucasus_conquest
	}
	c:MAJ ?= {
		add_area_preference = majapahit_conquest
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year > 1437
		}
		c:FRA ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:ENG ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:GBR ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:HOL ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:NED ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year > 1537
		}
		c:POR ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_african_colonization }
		c:HUN ?= { remove_area_preference = hungary_please_dont_kill_the_hre }
	}
	else = {
		c:HUN ?= { add_area_preference = hungary_please_dont_kill_the_hre }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year > 1637
		}
		c:SCO ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:DAN ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
		c:SWE ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_american_colonization }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year > 1737
		}
		c:FRA ?= {
			remove_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
		}
		c:ENG ?= {
			remove_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
		}
		c:GBR ?= {
			remove_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
		}
		c:HOL ?= {
			remove_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
		}
		c:NED ?= {
			remove_area_preference = avoid_oceania_colonization
			remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization
		}
		c:POR ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization }
		c:CAS ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization }
		c:SPA ?= { remove_area_preference = avoid_south_east_asica_colonization }
	}
}

update_cloth_silk_guild_industry_variable = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_location = {
				any_buildings_in_location = {
					OR = {
						building_produced_goods = goods:fine_cloth
						building_produced_goods = goods:silk
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = produces_fine_cloth_or_silk_variable
			value = 1
			years = 1
		}
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = produces_fine_cloth_or_silk_variable
	}
}
# Parameters
# character = character scope
# policy = policy scope
# has_policy = yes/no
on_ibadi_ruler_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				$character$ = { 
					NOT = { has_variable = ibadi_elected_via_action } # to prevent this from firing due to set_new_ruler. Currently on new ruler fires on the next tick, overwriting the change
				}
				$has_policy$ = yes
			}
		}
		remove_variable = weak_imam_penalty
	
		# If the target character has been appointed shari imam
		# and we still recognize the existence of such a policy, then change to it instead of zuhur.
		if = {
			limit = {
				$character$ = {
					has_variable = shari_imam
				}
				has_policy = ibadi_maintain_the_status_of_imam_policy
			}
			add_policy = policy:ibadi_shari_imam_policy
		}
		# For generic actions where we elect a particular policy alongside a ruler.
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				$has_policy$ = yes
			}
			add_policy = $policy$
		}
		else = {
			add_policy = policy:ibadi_zuhur_imam_policy
		}
	}
}

#character scope
remove_cardinal_variables = {
	reset_character_religious_figure = {}
	reset_character_location = {}
}

# location scope
set_up_cardinal = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = cardinal_seat_location
    owner = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_female = no
					has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
					religion = this.religion
					is_artist = no
					is_religious_order_member = no
					or = {
						is_religious_figure = no
						religious_figure != religious_figure:cardinal
					}
				}
			}
			#someone in the country
			random_character = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_female = no
					has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
					religion = this.religion
					is_artist = no
					is_religious_order_member = no
					or = {
						is_religious_figure = no
						religious_figure != religious_figure:cardinal
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_as = target_cardinal
			}
		}
		else = {
			#nobody suitable, create one
			create_character = {
				religion = this.religion
				female = no
				estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
				age = { 40 65 }
				save_temporary_scope_as = target_cardinal
			}
		}
    }
    scope:target_cardinal = {
		set_character_location = scope:cardinal_seat_location
		set_character_religious_figure = religious_figure:cardinal
    }
}
